title: Customer Due Diligence (CDD) & KYC Verification Checklist
content: Know Your Customer (KYC) Requirements: Every customer account requires identity verification through government-approved credentials (Aadhaar, PAN, Passport). Customers with PENDING status are restricted to basic savings accounts with monthly withdrawal limits not exceeding ₹50,000 and cannot apply for loans or credit cards. Full verification requires validated address proof and biometric or video KYC completion. Periodic re-KYC reviews occur every 24 months for medium risk profiles and every 12 months for high risk profiles.

passages.text: KYC verification checklist: Required documents include Government ID proof, Address verification, and PAN card. Customers with PENDING KYC are prohibited from receiving retail loan disbursement or overdraft facilities.
Re-verification schedule: High-risk customer profiles undergo mandatory annual compliance review. Unresolved documentation discrepancies within 30 days trigger simulated operational freeze warnings.
